help.intro: Care for Mote by reading its four needs — Hunger, Cleanliness, Fun, Energy — and choosing an action. Every action advances the clock and all needs slowly drain. Fulfil the objective before time runs out. Thought bubbles are cravings: grant them for bonus Trust. Neglect never causes permanent loss. Tap Mote to pet it.
help.keyboard: Keyboard: number keys act · {hint} hint · {undo} undo (practice) · {camera} camera · {pause} pause · arrow keys move between buttons.
help.gamepad: Gamepad: D-pad moves focus · A confirm · B cancel · Start pause.
